subject.title: feat(github-copilot): support GitHub Enterprise data-residency Copilot auth

question: After the compile blocker is fixed, should narrow *.ghe.com data-residency support live in the bundled GitHub Copilot provider, or should this remain ClawHub/plugin scope?
rationale: The branch fixes a real gap in an already-bundled provider, but it adds auth/config/env/SDK surface after a broader GHE integration request was closed as plugin scope, so automation should not decide the product boundary alone.

options.title: Accept narrow bundled support after repair
options.body: Keep this PR direction viable once the type error is fixed and the host allowlist, domain persistence, and legacy cache behavior stay covered by tests.

options.title: Route all GHE support to ClawHub
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask for a separate provider/plugin package if maintainers do not want enterprise-specific routing in bundled OpenClaw code.

options.title: Defer for a generic tenant-provider seam
options.body: Keep the work as design input if maintainers want a broader provider-domain contract before adding bundled behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow bundled support after repair
recommendation.body: Keep this PR direction viable once the type error is fixed and the host allowlist, domain persistence, and legacy cache behavior stay covered by tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc is the strongest current-main history owner for provider-auth and GitHub Copilot auth seams touched here.
